limitations: Static complete-loop/callee inspection, not executed branch counters, sampling or cycle attribution.
The outer try_set is admitted inline; its immediately invoked mutation-body lambda and inner proposal lambda are outlined. Do not truncate their demangled names and label them the outer function.
The maximum-family temporary creates a large stack frame but only family width is memset; the captured x86 prologue has no page-probing loop. Frame size alone does not establish a performance cost.

Runtime layout resolution before and after reservation is observable; pointer re-resolution after possible directory/payload growth is presently required by the owner contract. Any replacement must preserve refusal, observer ordering and exclusivity.
Existing author::append_unchecked can remove checked admission/dispatch after explicit owner proof. No missing primitive API is established here.

The ordinary baseline really has two inline values. Its inline promotion history and row footprint differ from the single-inline candidate; neither benchmark representation is artificially changed to equalize allocation work.
